text:
Dan (Eng Manager): FYI Eli (contractor) handed in notice today, last day 2026-05-31. Need offboard checklist and timeline for mid-quarter handoff.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks Dan — tagging IT, Security, Benefits, and Payroll. Main asks: laptop return, keycard deactivation, GH/org permissions, final invoice + last paycheck, and benefits/COBRA question.
Alex (IT): Can confirm laptop return + account removal. Will schedule a UPS pickup for company laptop if Eli can't drop off. Need serial and shipping address. Also will disable SSO on his last day unless you request early cutover.
Dan (Eng Manager): He has a MacBook Pro (serial MP1234XYZ). Eli said he can ship on 6/1 morning. We'd like GH access until EOD 5/31 for handover.
Alex (IT): OK mark pickup for 6/1 AM. I'll leave GH access until 23:59 5/31. Please confirm if any repos need longer.
Luis (Benefits): Quick note on COBRA: contractors aren't typically on our medical plan, but if he was on the contractor benefits package we need to confirm enrollment. @Maya can you confirm Eli's plan code?
Maya (People Ops): Eli enrolled in the contractor dental/vision bundle through our vendor, not medical. He opted out of medical, so no COBRA. I'll attach the enrollment screenshot in the offboarding ticket.
Security Ops: We'll schedule badge deactivation for 6/1 09:00. If Eli needs physical access for return earlier, reply with exact time.
Dan (Eng Manager): He wants to come by on 5/29 to drop a couple monitors and do final handoff. Can Security allow a one-time allowlist for 5/29 10:00-12:00?
Security Ops: One-time visit OK. We'll badge allowlist 5/29 09:45-12:15 and require escort. Please set meeting with Facilities.
Payroll Bot: Please submit final timesheet and contractor invoice via <https://payroll.redwood.com/submit> by 6/2 to ensure timely payment. Invoices must include invoice number and bank details for ACH.
Eli (Contractor): I'll submit final invoice Friday 6/2 morning. I can drop monitors 5/29 and leave laptop to UPS on 6/1 AM.
Maya (People Ops): Quick checklist I'm creating: 1) Confirm last working day 5/31 (Dan) 2) Schedule pickup 6/1 (Alex) 3) Badge allowlist 5/29 (Security) 4) Revoke GH/SSO 5/31 23:59 (Alex) 5) Final invoice + timesheet by 6/2 (Eli) 6) Benefits note: no COBRA (Luis) 7) 401(k) not applicable (contractor). Any missing items?
Dan (Eng Manager): Add: transfer outstanding PRs and assign oncall rotations for June. I'll update the PR owners.
Maya (People Ops): Noted. I'll open an offboarding ticket in HRIS and post the checklist + links: 
```
- Offboard ticket: https://hris.redwood.co/offboard/NEW
- Laptop return instructions: https://eng.redwood.co/it/laptop-return
- Invoice submit: https://payroll.redwood.com/submit
```
Alex (IT): For the pickup, send shipping address + contact number to it-ops@redwood.co. Also to confirm: wipe and reinstall image on receipt? Our standard is to reimage and then store.
Dan (Eng Manager): Reimage is fine. Also please copy any small-piece config files from his laptop (local dotfiles) to the team repo before wipe if Eli consents.
Eli (Contractor): Consent given for copying repository-related dotfiles. Please dont take personal files.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll track on the offboard ticket and ping when each step is complete. Closing note: final pay + invoice typically paid within 7 business days after invoice clearance; payroll bot will update status. :white_check_mark:
Payroll Bot: Invoice received -> status pending approval once timesheet verification completes.
Maya (People Ops): I'll update this thread when pickup/time window and badge escort are confirmed.
